title: المجموعة السابعة: المشاعر والآراء والانطباعات
status: 18 authored patterns, 72 contextual scenes, 54 micro-story lines, 36 dialogues, three linked stories; realistic photographs intentionally deferred; voice recording subject to verified audio pipeline

items.title: I feel
items.explanation: نصف حالتنا الشعورية باستخدام صفة بعد feel، وليس اسمًا بلا أداة مناسبة.
items.explanationEn: Use I feel with an adjective to describe how you feel now. Feel can describe physical or emotional states.
items.contrast: I feel tired تصف الحالة؛ I feel like resting تعبر عن الرغبة في فعل شيء.

scenes.en: I feel calm after my walk.
I feel nervous before an exam.
I feel better today.
I feel sad when I miss my family.
scenes.ar: أشعر بالحزن عندما أشتاق إلى عائلتي.

story.en: Maya had a busy morning.
She took a short walk outside.
After the walk, she said, 'I feel calm now.'
story.ar: بعد المشي قالت: أشعر بالهدوء الآن.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: How do you feel after the walk?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I feel relaxed and happy.

items.title: I'm happy with
items.explanation: نعبر عن الرضا بنتيجة أو شيء باستخدام with، وليس عن السعادة عمومًا فقط.
items.explanationEn: Use happy with to express satisfaction with a result, choice, or thing.
items.contrast: I'm happy with my work رضا بالنتيجة؛ I feel happy شعور بالسعادة عمومًا.

scenes.en: I'm happy with my test result.
I'm happy with our new classroom.
I'm happy with the final design.
I'm happy with the way we worked together.
scenes.ar: أنا سعيد بالطريقة التي عملنا بها معًا.

story.en: Hassan worked hard on his drawing.
He showed it to his teacher.
He was happy with the result.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What do you think of your project?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'm happy with the result.

items.title: I'm worried about
items.formula: I'm worried about + noun or verb ending in ing
items.explanation: نعبر عن القلق بشأن شخص أو أمر باستخدام about يليها اسم أو صيغة ing.
items.explanationEn: Use worried about to express concern about someone or something.
items.contrast: I'm worried about the test قلق؛ I'm excited about the test حماس.

scenes.en: I'm worried about tomorrow's exam.
I'm worried about my friend's health.
I'm worried about missing the bus.
I'm worried about the heavy rain.

story.en: Rania heard that her brother was sick.
She was worried about his health.
She called him and felt relieved.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Why are you quiet today?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'm worried about my brother.

items.title: I'm proud of
items.formula: I'm proud of + person or achievement
items.explanation: نستخدم proud of للتعبير عن الفخر بإنجاز أو بشخص، وقد نعبر عن الفخر بأنفسنا.
items.explanationEn: Use proud of for a person or an achievement that makes you feel proud.
items.contrast: I'm proud of you فخر بإنجاز؛ I'm happy with you تعبير مختلف بحسب السياق.

scenes.en: I'm proud of my sister's success.
I'm proud of our team.
I'm proud of my progress in English.
I'm proud of you for trying again.
scenes.ar: أنا فخور بك لأنك حاولت مجددًا.

story.en: Ali practiced reading every day.
story.ar: تدرب علي على القراءة كل يوم.

story.en: His teacher noticed his improvement.
She said, 'I'm proud of your progress.'

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I finally finished the book!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'm proud of you!

items.title: I'm surprised that
items.explanation: نستخدم surprised that للتعجب من معلومة أو نتيجة غير متوقعة، ويمكن حذف that في الحديث الطبيعي.
items.explanationEn: Use surprised that followed by a complete clause to react to unexpected information.
items.contrast: I'm surprised that she won تعجب من خبر؛ I'm surprised by the gift تعجب من شيء.

scenes.en: I'm surprised that you remember my name.
I'm surprised that the shop is open.
I'm surprised that he finished so early.
scenes.ar: أنا متفاجئ بأنه انتهى مبكرًا جدًا.

scenes.en: I'm surprised that this book is so interesting.
scenes.ar: أنا متفاجئ بأن هذا الكتاب ممتع جدًا.

story.en: Lina entered the library after school.
She found her favorite author there.
She said, 'I'm surprised that he's here!'
story.ar: قالت: أنا متفاجئة من وجوده هنا!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Did you know Sara won the prize?
dialogue.ar: هل علمت أن سارة فازت بالجائزة؟

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'm surprised that she won!

items.title: I'm disappointed that
items.explanation: نعبر عن خيبة الأمل بسبب حدث أو نتيجة؛ الوصف هنا شعور تجاه ما وقع.
items.explanationEn: Use disappointed that followed by a clause to describe an unmet expectation.
items.contrast: I'm disappointed that it was canceled خيبة أمل؛ I'm surprised that it was canceled دهشة.

scenes.en: I'm disappointed that the game was canceled.
I'm disappointed that we lost the match.
I'm disappointed that the package is late.
I'm disappointed that I missed the concert.

story.en: Noura planned a picnic with her friends.
Rain forced them to cancel it.
She was disappointed that the picnic was canceled.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: How do you feel about the canceled trip?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'm disappointed that we can't go.
dialogue.ar: أنا محبط لأننا لا نستطيع الذهاب.

items.title: I'm grateful for
items.explanation: نعبر عن الامتنان لشيء تلقيناه أو فرصة حصلنا عليها باستخدام for؛ ونستخدم grateful to لمن ساعدنا.
items.explanationEn: Use grateful for a gift, kindness, or opportunity. Use grateful to for the person you thank.
items.contrast: I'm grateful for your help مساعدة؛ I'm grateful to you شخص ساعدني.

scenes.en: I'm grateful for your kindness.
I'm grateful for this opportunity.
I'm grateful for my family's support.
I'm grateful for the time you gave me.
scenes.ar: أنا ممتن للوقت الذي خصصته لي.

story.en: Khaled was struggling with his lesson.
story.ar: كان خالد يواجه صعوبة في الدرس.

story.en: His friend explained it slowly.
Khaled said, 'I'm grateful for your help.'

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I'm glad the explanation helped.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'm grateful for your patience.

items.title: I'm interested in
items.formula: I'm interested in + noun or verb ending in ing
items.explanation: نستخدم interested in للتعبير عن اهتمام حقيقي بموضوع أو نشاط، ويأتي الفعل بعد in بصيغة ing.
items.explanationEn: Use interested in before a topic, noun, or an activity ending in ing.
items.contrast: I'm interested in painting اهتمام؛ I'm good at painting مهارة.

scenes.en: I'm interested in learning new languages.
I'm interested in space and science.
I'm interested in improving my writing.
I'm interested in joining the art club.
scenes.ar: أنا مهتم بالانضمام إلى نادي الفن.

story.en: Mariam saw a poster for a science club.
She was interested in joining it.
She asked her teacher how to register.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Would you like to join the club?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes, I'm interested in science.

items.title: I feel like
items.formula: I feel like + verb ending in ing
items.explanation: عندما يأتي بعد feel like فعل بصيغة ing نعبر عن الرغبة الآنية، لا عن شعور جسدي.
items.explanationEn: Use feel like followed by an activity ending in ing to express what you want to do.
items.contrast: I feel like walking أرغب في المشي؛ I feel tired أشعر بالتعب.

scenes.en: I feel like taking a short walk.
I feel like reading a story.
I feel like drinking some water.
I feel like listening to music.

story.en: Fahd finished his homework early.
He felt like going outside.
He asked his father to join him for a walk.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What do you want to do now?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I feel like reading a story.

items.title: I don't feel like
items.formula: I don't feel like + verb ending in ing
items.explanation: للتعبير بلطف عن عدم الرغبة الحالية في نشاط معين، وليس رفضه إلى الأبد.
items.explanationEn: Use don't feel like before an activity ending in ing when you are not in the mood.
items.contrast: I don't feel like going out رغبة الآن؛ I won't go قرار أو رفض للمستقبل.

scenes.en: I don't feel like going out tonight.
I don't feel like watching TV.
scenes.ar: لا أشعر برغبة في مشاهدة التلفاز.

scenes.en: I don't feel like eating yet.
I don't feel like talking right now.

story.en: Salma came home after a long day.
story.ar: عادت سلمى إلى المنزل بعد يوم طويل.

story.en: She didn't feel like going out.
She stayed home and rested.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Shall we go for a walk?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I don't feel like walking now.

items.title: I think
items.explanation: نقدم رأيًا أو تقديرًا شخصيًا باستخدام I think، وقد نحذف that، ولا يُعامل الرأي حقيقة مؤكدة.
items.explanationEn: Use I think before a complete clause to share an opinion or judgment.
items.contrast: I think it's useful رأي؛ I know it's useful معرفة أو تأكد.

scenes.en: I think this lesson is useful.
I think the blue shirt looks better.
scenes.ar: أعتقد أن القميص الأزرق يبدو أفضل.

scenes.en: I think we should start early.
scenes.ar: أعتقد أنه ينبغي أن نبدأ مبكرًا.

scenes.en: I think this story has a good ending.
scenes.ar: أعتقد أن لهذه القصة نهاية جيدة.

story.en: Omar read a new story at school.
story.ar: قرأ عمر قصة جديدة في المدرسة.

story.en: He thought the ending was interesting.
He shared his opinion with his classmates.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What do you think of this idea?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I think it's a great idea.

items.title: In my opinion
items.explanation: نوضح أن الكلام رأينا الشخصي، ويستحسن إسناده إلى سبب بدل تقديمه كحقيقة مطلقة.
items.explanationEn: Use in my opinion before a sentence to make it clear you are giving a personal view.
items.contrast: In my opinion رأي واضح؛ In fact تستخدم لتقديم حقيقة أو تصحيح.

scenes.en: In my opinion, reading every day helps.
In my opinion, the park is a great place to relax.
scenes.ar: في رأيي، الحديقة مكان رائع للاسترخاء.

scenes.en: In my opinion, we need more practice.
scenes.ar: في رأيي، نحتاج إلى مزيد من التدريب.

scenes.en: In my opinion, teamwork is important.

story.en: The class discussed ways to study better.
Huda listened to her classmates.
She said, 'In my opinion, short daily practice is best.'
story.ar: قالت: في رأيي، التدريب اليومي القصير هو الأفضل.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Which study method do you prefer?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: In my opinion, daily practice works best.
dialogue.ar: في رأيي، التدريب اليومي هو الأفضل.

items.title: I believe
items.explanation: نستخدم believe للتعبير عن اعتقاد أو قناعة، وقد يكون أرسخ من I think بحسب السياق.
items.explanationEn: Use I believe to express a belief or conviction. It can sound stronger than I think.
items.contrast: I believe we can succeed قناعة؛ I think we can succeed رأي أو تقدير.

scenes.en: I believe everyone can learn.
I believe we can solve this problem.
scenes.ar: أعتقد أننا نستطيع حل هذه المشكلة.

scenes.en: I believe honesty is important.
I believe practice makes a difference.

story.en: Yasser tried a difficult exercise.
At first, he wanted to give up.
His teacher said, 'I believe you can do it.'
story.ar: قال معلمه: أؤمن أنك قادر على فعله.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Do you think we can finish?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I believe we can finish together.

items.title: I prefer
items.formula: I prefer + noun or verb ending in ing + to + alternative
items.explanation: نستخدم prefer للمقارنة بين اختيارين، وقد يأتي بعده اسم أو فعل بصيغة ing مع to للمقارنة.
items.explanationEn: Use prefer to express your choice between alternatives, often with to before the second choice.
items.contrast: I prefer tea to coffee اختيار مفضل؛ I'd rather drink tea تفضيل لفعل بصيغة مختلفة.

scenes.en: I prefer tea to coffee.
I prefer walking to driving.
I prefer studying in the morning.
I prefer quiet places to crowded ones.

story.en: Nadia visited two cafés near her school.
One was quiet, and the other was noisy.
She preferred the quiet café.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Would you like tea or coffee?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I prefer tea to coffee.

items.title: I agree with
items.formula: I agree with + person or opinion
items.explanation: لإبداء الاتفاق مع شخص نستخدم with، ونستخدم agree on عند تحديد مسألة مشتركة.
items.explanationEn: Use agree with for a person or a viewpoint, and agree on for a shared decision.
items.contrast: I agree with you أتفق معك؛ I agree on a date اتفقنا على موعد.

scenes.en: I agree with your suggestion.
I agree with my teacher on this point.
scenes.ar: أتفق مع معلمي في هذه النقطة.

scenes.en: I agree with you about the schedule.
I agree with her decision.

story.en: The team discussed their next project.
Sara suggested a simple plan.
Ali said, 'I agree with your idea.'

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Do you think we should start early?
dialogue.ar: هل تظن أنه ينبغي أن نبدأ مبكرًا؟

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes, I agree with you.

items.title: I don't agree with
items.formula: I don't agree with + person or opinion
items.explanation: نستخدمه للتعبير عن اختلاف الرأي باحترام؛ يمكن أن نوضح السبب ونقترح بديلًا.
items.explanationEn: Use don't agree with to disagree respectfully with a person or opinion.
items.contrast: I don't agree with the plan خلاف في الرأي؛ I don't understand the plan عدم فهم.

scenes.en: I don't agree with that idea.
I don't agree with the new schedule.
I don't agree with his conclusion.
I don't agree with every part of the plan.
scenes.ar: لا أتفق مع كل جزء من الخطة.

story.en: Kareem listened carefully during the meeting.
He didn't agree with one suggestion.
He explained his reasons politely.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Do you agree with this change?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I don't agree with it, but I respect your view.
dialogue.ar: لا أتفق معه، لكنني أحترم رأيك.

items.title: It seems like
items.explanation: نعبر عن انطباع أو استنتاج غير مؤكد يعتمد على قرائن، وليس عن حقيقة مُثبتة.
items.explanationEn: Use it seems like to describe an impression drawn from what you notice.
items.contrast: It seems like she's tired استنتاج؛ She is tired تقرير أقوى عن حالتها.

scenes.en: It seems like the shop is closed.
It seems like everyone is ready.
It seems like the weather is changing.
It seems like she enjoyed the party.

story.en: Mona walked past the school gate.
The lights were off and no one was outside.
story.ar: كانت الأنوار مطفأة ولم يكن أحد في الخارج.

story.en: She said, 'It seems like the school is closed.'

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Why are the doors locked?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: It seems like the building is closed.

items.title: It sounds like
items.formula: It sounds like + noun or clause
items.explanation: نعبر عن انطباع مصدره ما نسمعه، سواء صوتًا فعليًا أو وصفًا سمعناه من شخص.
items.explanationEn: Use it sounds like when your impression comes from what you hear or what someone tells you.
items.contrast: It sounds like rain صوت؛ It looks like rain منظر؛ It seems like rain انطباع عام.

scenes.en: It sounds like rain outside.
scenes.ar: يبدو أن المطر يتساقط في الخارج من صوته.

scenes.en: It sounds like a great idea.
scenes.ar: تبدو فكرة رائعة من وصفك لها.

scenes.en: It sounds like someone is at the door.
scenes.ar: يبدو أن هناك شخصًا عند الباب من الصوت.

scenes.en: It sounds like the children are having fun.
scenes.ar: يبدو أن الأطفال يستمتعون من أصواتهم.

story.en: Amir heard laughter from the garden.
His little cousins were playing outside.
story.ar: كان أبناء عمه الصغار يلعبون بالخارج.

story.en: He said, 'It sounds like they're having fun.'
story.ar: قال: يبدو أنهم يستمتعون من أصواتهم.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Can you hear that noise outside?
dialogue.ar: هل تسمع ذلك الصوت في الخارج؟

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: It sounds like heavy rain.
dialogue.ar: يبدو من صوته أنه مطر غزير.

lines.en: It was Maya's first day at a new school.
lines.ar: كان ذلك أول يوم لمايا في مدرستها الجديدة.

lines.en: She felt nervous before entering the classroom.
Her teacher welcomed her with a kind smile.
Maya said, 'I'm grateful for your kindness.'
At lunchtime, she told a friend, 'I feel happy now.'
lines.ar: وقت الغداء قالت لصديقة: أشعر بالسعادة الآن.

lines.en: She was proud of herself for trying something new.
lines.ar: شعرت بالفخر بنفسها لأنها جربت شيئًا جديدًا.

lines.en: Omar and Lina planned a class reading corner.
lines.ar: خطط عمر ولينا لركن قراءة صفي.

lines.en: Omar said, 'I think we need more shelves.'
lines.ar: قال عمر: أعتقد أننا نحتاج إلى مزيد من الرفوف.

lines.en: Lina replied, 'In my opinion, we should add more books first.'
lines.ar: ردت لينا: في رأيي، علينا إضافة كتب أكثر أولًا.

lines.en: Omar said, 'I don't agree with every part of that plan.'
lines.ar: قال عمر: لا أتفق مع كل جزء من تلك الخطة.

lines.en: They listened to each other respectfully.
lines.ar: استمع كل منهما إلى الآخر باحترام.

lines.en: Finally, they agreed to begin with a small shelf and new books.
lines.ar: وأخيرًا اتفقا على البدء برف صغير وكتب جديدة.

lines.en: Noura was worried about her friend's big exam.
lines.ar: كانت نورة قلقة بشأن اختبار صديقتها المهم.

lines.en: After the exam, her friend came to visit.
She brought a handmade card to say thank you.
lines.ar: أحضرت بطاقة مصنوعة يدويًا للتعبير عن الشكر.

lines.en: Noura said, 'I'm surprised that you made this for me!'
lines.ar: قالت نورة: أنا متفاجئة أنك صنعتِ هذه من أجلي!

lines.en: Her friend replied, 'I'm grateful for your support.'
It seemed like a small gift, but it meant a lot.
lines.ar: بدت هدية صغيرة، لكنها حملت معنى كبيرًا.

skills: التعبير عن الشعور والرضا والقلق والفخر
انطباع عام أو سمعي دون ادعاء اليقين
